title: Nothing private reaches any linked-data output
description:
As Ryan, I want every linked-data output built from a fixed field allowlist, so that private facts cannot leak by accident. Editor words on a link stay private (Ryan decision 1).

```gherkin
Feature: Public outputs are built from an allowlist
  Scenario: The field set is pinned
    Given the list of fields each linked-data output may carry
    When a field is added to an output without being added to the list
    Then the build fails

  Scenario: Private facts stay private
    Given a Reference with a star rating, a vote reason and an editor's note on a link
    When every linked-data output of the site is built
    Then none of them contains the rating, the reason, the note or an editor's account
```
